title: THE SOCIETAL IMPACT OF FOUNDATION MODELS: ADVANCING EVIDENCE-BASED AI POLICY
findings: On the CivilComments toxicity detection task, almost all models were found to be considerably more accurate and robust for comments mentioning Christians as compared to comments mentioning Muslims. For example, Anthropic's 52B model showed improved accuracy for the Christian subset but a decline in accuracy for the Muslim subset compared to its overall performance.
